# Locked Android plugin compatibility

These five existing packages retain their exact Dart/native APIs and original licenses. They are vendored to declare their original Android namespace under AGP 8, remove deprecated manifest package attributes, and align the two Kotlin plugins with their existing Java 8 bytecode target. No network, permission or platform behavior is added. UPSTREAM.json records package versions, origin and original pubspec digests. Native package source and licenses ship in the corresponding-source archive. uni_links' license and analyzer settings are materialized from its upstream parent files so that their original symlink targets remain available in this directory layout. Dependency test sources are retained; their separate dev dependencies and mocks are not part of the application analyzer or widget suite.
